name: BOZHON Precision Industry Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: BOZHON Precision Industry Technology Co.,Ltd, established in 2006 and based in Suzhou, China, specializes in developing and delivering comprehensive solutions and services for digital factory systems. The company operates both domestically within China and across international markets. Its digital factory offerings integrate various advanced technologies, including industrial automation machinery, automated production lines, specialized automation jigs, intelligent warehousing and logistics systems, information devices, and complete system integration. These innovative solutions cater to diverse sectors such as consumer electronics, automotive, new energy, and other manufacturing industries. For the consumer electronics sector, BOZHON provides tailored equipment like welding systems, dispensing units, air tightness testing apparatus, vision laser measuring devices, high-speed assembly lines, automated assembly equipment, industrial robot integration, and high-speed automatic loading and unloading machinery. Beyond specific equipment, the company's broader digital factory services encompass strategic planning and consulting for factory layouts, information technology systems, warehouse management, and fixtures. They also cover precision machining (including modifications and assembly), material flow systems, and connectivity solutions. Furthermore, BOZHON supplies critical systems for the new energy vehicle industry, such as charging stations, vehicle electronics, battery module production lines, and material manufacturing systems. A range of standard equipment is also available, including various testing devices, high-precision measuring instruments, and general process equipment.
